Products / MMA & Grappling Shorts / Dazzle Vector

TONTON · CUSTOM COMBAT TRAINING SHORTS · OEM / ODM

Dazzle Vector Combat Training Shorts

Build a distinctive MMA, Muay Thai or kickboxing training collection around black-and-white geometric stripes and a contrast red drawcord. This shorts reference combines a gathered elastic waist, curved scallop openings and a visible micro-dot mesh inner layer.

  • Custom geometric stripe artwork and TONTON crest placement
  • Red drawcord and multi-row elastic waistband
  • Scalloped side openings with finished edges
  • Mesh lining details for your selected construction
Request Custom Shorts & Sample Plan

Front, back and on-body reference views

Model views illustrate a coordinated outfit. This page specifies the shorts; request the rash guard separately. Confirm measurements and fit on your own approved size set.

Three construction details to review during sampling

Gathered waist and contrast red drawcord

Review relaxed and stretched waist measurements, drawcord route, cord ends and waist recovery on the sample.

Scallop opening and mesh inner layer

Confirm side-opening depth, mesh coverage, binding and seam finish in stance, knee lift and squat positions.

Geometric stripe artwork and seam alignment

Use separate panel files for stripe direction, logo scale and seam allowances. Check alignment and printed color on the physical sample.

Product design presentation

Generated design presentation · Approximately 15 seconds. Supplied product photographs and the approved physical sample remain the construction reference.

Ripstop structure, water repellency, abrasion resistance, drying rate and print durability require material records or agreed testing. They are not inferred from photographs.

Buyer questions

Can you customize the stripe design and red drawcord?

Yes. Send authorized logos, geometric artwork, team colors, cord color, labels and packaging requirements. Approve panel placement and a physical sample before bulk production.

What is the fabric composition and weight?

The reference is supplied as a lightweight stretch shell with a micro-dot mesh inner layer. Exact shell and mesh fiber percentages, GSM and stretch requirements are confirmed in the project specification; 92% polyester / 8% spandex and 140–160 GSM are not confirmed specifications for this item.

Does the mesh form a compression liner?

The supplied images show a mesh inner layer and mesh at the hem. They do not establish a fitted compression-short liner. Confirm liner coverage, stretch and finish on the selected sample.

Can these shorts be used for competition?

This is a training and product-development reference. External drawcords, split height, coverage and other details must be checked against the named event rules. Request a separate competition specification when needed.

Can we order matching rash guards?

Yes. Coordinated team-kit artwork can be developed with separate sizing and specifications for the rash guard and shorts. The top shown in model imagery is a styling reference and is not included in this shorts specification.

What is the MOQ and sampling process?

Selected custom projects start from 10 pieces; the applicable minimum depends on style, fabric, artwork, colorway and size allocation. Send your quantity, sizes, delivery country and target date for a written quotation and sample plan.

Plan your custom geometric fightwear collection

Send artwork, estimated quantity, size allocation, construction priorities, delivery country and target date. TONTON will review the material selection, sample route and project-specific quotation.
